Dry samples were oven conditioned at 105 degC for at least 48 hours with mass monitoring, then kept over desiccant until testing. The protocol does not establish an exact residual moisture, unchanged chemistry or a reversible drying law. The conditioning temperature is not a service-temperature limit. HFM capacity generally follows ASTM C1784-20 equal-plate temperature steps; conductivity generally follows ASTM C518 through thickness with upward heat flow. Contact pressure and axis mapping are unreported. Unconditioned source populations are stored separately.
